questions.question: Which marketplace model should the product support?
questions.rationale: The inDrive-like description suggests a marketplace but does not establish whether the focus is passengers, freight, fleets, or a hybrid.

options.label: Driver and customer marketplace
options.description: Connect independent drivers with people or businesses requesting transport.

options.label: Business freight marketplace
options.description: Focus on shippers and commercial transport providers.

options.label: Fleet dispatch platform
options.description: Help one or more fleet operators dispatch their own drivers.

options.label: Hybrid
options.description: Support more than one of the models above.

options.label: Other
options.description: Describe a different marketplace model.

questions.question: Who are the intended users at launch?
questions.rationale: The request identifies drivers but does not specify the demand-side customer groups.

options.label: Drivers and individual riders
options.description: Individual passengers request trips from drivers.

options.label: Drivers and freight shippers
options.description: Individuals or businesses request goods transport.

options.label: Drivers, riders, and freight shippers
options.description: Include passenger and freight demand.

options.label: Fleet operators and their drivers
options.description: Organizations manage vehicles, drivers, and dispatch.

options.label: Other
options.description: Describe the user groups.

options.label: Passenger trips
options.description: Point-to-point rides for people.

options.label: Freight and goods transport
options.description: Move parcels, cargo, or commercial loads.

options.label: Both passenger trips and freight
options.description: Support both types of transport in the initial product.

options.label: Other / not yet decided
options.description: Describe the intended scope or leave it open.

options.label: Mobile app

options.label: Other / undecided

questions.question: What backend capabilities are essential for the MVP?
questions.rationale: Marketplace workflows and operational capabilities remain to be defined.

questions.question: Which data stores or supporting storage are required?
questions.rationale: A transport marketplace needs persistent accounts and trip/offer state. File or media storage is not assumed; select Blob Storage if the product will store or serve documents, photos, uploads, or other media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Only for a stateless or entirely local prototype with no persisted marketplace data.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational storage for accounts, trips, offers, and marketplace records.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for documents, photos, uploads, or other files.

options.label: Redis
options.description: Optional cache or transient coordination store.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify another datastore or supporting storage.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: Driver onboarding and marketplace participation imply user accounts; confirm whether sign-in is required for the MVP.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Drivers and/or customers have accounts and sign in to use marketplace features.

options.label: No
options.description: The MVP has no sign-in for application API features.

questions.question: Which interface language(s) should the MVP support?
questions.rationale: Egypt is the target market, but language priority and dialect/localization preferences are not specified.

options.label: Arabic first
options.description: Arabic is the primary interface language; specify whether English is also needed.

options.label: Arabic and English
options.description: Offer both Arabic and English interfaces.

options.label: English first
options.description: English is the primary interface language; specify whether Arabic is also needed.

options.label: Decide later
options.description: Defer language selection while keeping localization in mind.

questions.question: Which payment methods should be in scope for the MVP? Select the launch priority and add any combination details.

options.label: Mobile wallets

options.label: Cards
options.description: Accept card payments through an appropriate payment provider.

options.label: Cash and digital payments
options.description: Support cash plus one or more digital payment methods.

options.label: No in-app payments in MVP
options.description: Payment is handled outside the application for the initial release.

options.label: Undecided
options.description: Defer the payment decision.

options.label: Basic profile with manual approval

options.label: Undecided

options.label: Basic account only

options.label: Identity verification
options.description: Require an identity-check process before specified actions.

options.label: Different rules by customer type
options.description: Use separate onboarding rules for individuals and businesses.

options.label: Undecided

questions.question: How should dispatch, matching, and price offers work?
questions.rationale: The inDrive-like reference may imply negotiation, but the exact offer and dispatch rules are not confirmed.

options.label: Customer posts a request and drivers make offers
options.description: A request is visible to eligible drivers who can propose a fare or terms.

options.label: Fixed fare with automatic matching
options.description: The platform sets or calculates the fare and assigns an available driver.

options.label: Customer chooses from driver quotes
options.description: Drivers submit quotes and the customer chooses one.

options.label: Direct booking with a selected driver
options.description: Customers request a chosen driver rather than a marketplace-wide match.

options.label: Combination or other
options.description: Describe a hybrid or different workflow.

options.label: Undecided
options.description: Defer dispatch and negotiation design.

options.label: Other / undecided
